Announcement.message: Give great clothes a second life · New pieces added every day

Home.title: Slow fashion, second life.
Home.description: Every piece you buy or sell keeps good clothing in circulation — and out of landfill. Buyers and sellers connect directly, no middleman checkout.
Home.emptyBody: Nothing has been published yet — freshly listed pieces will appear here first.
Home.sellBandHeading: Your closet clean-out can do good.
Home.sellBandBody: List your pre-loved pieces in minutes. Buyers message you directly — you agree on price and handover between yourselves.
Home.heroPhotoAlt: A rack of colourful pre-loved dresses at the Galerija boutique.
Home.insideBody: A glimpse into our world — where every piece has a story, and every detail matters.
Home.insidePhoto1Alt: A gold arch mirror beside racks of clothing on a patterned rug inside the Galerija boutique.
Home.insidePhoto2Alt: Galerija branded shopping bags and shoes arranged on a patterned rug.
Home.insidePhoto3Alt: Sheer curtains and racks of colourful clothing in a corner of the Galerija boutique.
Home.sustainabilityBody: By choosing second-hand, you help keep good clothing in circulation and out of landfill — a more circular future, one piece at a time.
Home.sustainabilityPhotoAlt: A rack of pre-loved clothing by a sunlit window at the Galerija boutique.

Footer.description: A classifieds marketplace for pre-loved fashion. Buyers and sellers connect directly — every rehomed piece keeps good clothing in circulation.
Footer.securePayments: Secure payments by CaSys · Visa · Mastercard · Maestro

meta.pricingDescription: Seller subscription plans for Galerija — publish listings on a monthly plan.

page.heading: Your closet clean-out can do good.
page.intro: Galerija is a classifieds marketplace: you keep 100% of what you sell. Buyers contact you directly, and payment and delivery stay between you and the buyer.

devHint.title: Development testing access
devHint.body: Subscription enforcement is off in this environment, so an approved seller account can test listing creation. Provision your account (development only):

buyerOnboarding.alertBody: Seller subscriptions will be required before production launch, and the bank payment integration is still being configured. You'll need an active seller profile before you can create listings.
buyerOnboarding.body: In-app seller onboarding (profile + subscription) arrives in a later update. When it's ready you'll be able to set up your seller profile here.

profileRequired.title: Complete your seller profile
profileRequired.body: Your account has seller access but no seller profile yet. A seller profile is required before creating listings. In-app profile completion arrives in a later update.

notActive.title: Seller account not active
notActive.body: Your seller account is currently {status}, so you can't create or publish listings. Please contact support.

subscriptionRequired.alertBody: Publishing listings requires an active seller subscription. Your account is ready — only the payment step remains.
subscriptionRequired.cardBody: The bank payment integration is awaiting configuration, so subscription checkout is not available yet. No payment is taken and no charge is created by viewing this page. Please check back once payment setup is complete.

dashboard.subtitle: Your listings, plan and conversations in one place.
dashboard.onboardingTitle: Set up selling to get started
dashboard.onboardingBody: Your account can sell, but you don't have a seller profile yet. Start a listing and we'll guide you through the rest.
dashboard.sellBody: Ready to give another piece a second life? List it in a few minutes.
dashboard.planCancelling: Cancellation scheduled at the end of the current period.

listings.heading: Your listings
listings.emptyBody: Create your first listing — add photos, set a price, and publish when it's ready.

newListing.heading: Create a listing
newListing.intro: Save a draft any time; publish when it's ready. Buyers contact you directly — Galerija doesn't process the sale.
newListing.profileRequiredBody: Your account has the seller role but no seller profile yet. In-app seller onboarding arrives in a later increment. For development, an operator can provision one:

entitlement.devBody: Subscription enforcement is off in this environment, so publishing is gated only by an active seller account. Subscription and weekly-quota enforcement arrive in a later increment — there is no subscription or payment behind this yet.
entitlement.subTitle: Publishing requires a subscription
entitlement.subBody: You can save drafts freely. Publishing requires an active seller subscription; the bank payment integration is awaiting configuration, so publishing is unavailable until it is connected.

edit.readOnlyBody: Editing and lifecycle actions for {status} listings arrive in a later increment. You can still see it in your listings.

subscriptionPage.heading: Subscription
subscriptionPage.noSubBody: You don't have a subscription yet. Choose a plan to start publishing listings.

pricing.heading: Sell on Galerija
pricing.intro: Browsing and messaging are always free. Sellers choose a plan to publish listings. Payments are processed securely by {gateway} in {currency}; Galerija never stores your card details.
pricing.comingSoonBody: Subscription plans aren't available yet. Please check back shortly.
pricing.publishUpTo: Publish up to {quota} listings per week
pricing.legal: By subscribing you agree to our <terms>Terms of Service</terms> and <refunds>Refunds & Cancellation policy</refunds>. Manage or cancel anytime from your <subscription>subscription page</subscription>.

lifecycle.heading: Manage listing
lifecycle.intro: Update where this listing appears. Changes take effect immediately.
lifecycle.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

markSold.title: Mark as sold?
markSold.body: This listing will no longer appear as available in the marketplace. Existing conversations stay accessible. Galerija doesn't process the sale — this only marks the item sold.

markAvailable.title: Mark as available again?
markAvailable.body: This republishes the listing to the marketplace. Your seller access and any subscription rules still apply.

archive.title: Archive listing?
archive.body: Archived listings are hidden from the marketplace and your active lists. You can relist them later.

Favorites.title: Saved items
Favorites.emptyBody: Tap the heart on any listing to keep it here. Your saved items sync to your account across devices.
